children: Intelligent Protection Management’s third-quarter revenue rose 75.5% year over year, led by a sharp increase in procurement sales alongside modest growth in managed IT and professional services. Net loss narrowed as lower sales and administrative, depreciation and litigation expenses partly offset higher procurement costs.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Revenue increased 271.2% year over year, as equipment sales drove growth; procurement’s larger revenue mix generally carries lower gross margins.
: Revenue increased 1.8%; growth from new and expanded customer relationships was partly offset by an 11.5% decline in Newtek-related revenue.
: Revenue fell 10.4% year over year, primarily due to increased competition in virtual camera and streaming software.
: The company launched an AI Data Readiness solution, achieved SOC 2 Type 1 compliance and extended its Phoenix data center agreement through August 2032.
: Deferred revenue was $4.9M at September 30, 2026, and supply chain constraints improved in the third quarter, though further shipment delays remain possible.
